IPL Auction Date and Venue Announced for December in Goa

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) Secretary, Devjit Saikia, announced that the Indian Premier League (IPL) auction for this year will be held in Goa in December. This marks the return of the IPL auction to India after several years of being held overseas. Additionally, matches for the India A women's team have been shifted from Dharamshala to Mohali due to inclement weather.
